entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and you've reached VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I'm a bit confused. I have this helmet I ordered, and I think I need to return it. It's just... the website was a little overwhelming and I'm not sure what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you please provide your order number?
Oh, sure. Let me see... It's VF-8675-309. I think.
Thank you. Let me pull that up. I see an Urban Commuter Helmet, delivered on November 26th. That was 23 days ago. Is that the correct item?
Yes, that's the one. The box is still unopened. I just realized the color isn't what I thought it would be. I feel a bit silly.
I understand. Just to be sure, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or a preference regarding the finish?

It's just the color. It's glossier than I expected from the pictures. With an important safety item like this, I want to be completely happy with it. The whole process is confusing. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. Let me just quickly review our current return policy for you. One moment please.
Alright, thanks for your patience. I've checked the policy, and since your order was delivered 23 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window.

Since you've confirmed the box is unopened, I can go ahead and approve this return immediately. I am generating a prepaid return label and sending it to the email address we have on file for you. Do you still have access to that email?
Oh! That's wonderful! Yes, I do. I was so worried it would be a problem. Thank you so much for making that easy.

You're very welcome. Just print the label, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, David.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
